verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for YubiKey, since it ships companion software (ykman CLI, Yubico Authenticator, SDKs) that could collect usage data. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
